svg.font-family: Nirmala UI, Noto Sans Telugu, sans-serif
svg.title: వందలు, పదులు, ఒకట్లు / Base-ten block model
svg.desc: వందలు: 4; పదులు: 0; ఒకట్లు: 7. 4 hundred squares, each a 10-by-10 grid; 0 ten rods, each 10 unit cells; 7 single unit cells. A zero-count column contains no blocks. The numerical answer is not printed.
